subject: New brand palette: magenta to violet to blue
body:
Sampled from the reference artwork rather than eyeballed - magenta #d451fe,
violet #6651d8, blue #00a3e3 - then adjusted for legibility on the dark
surface and checked against it:

  core       #22b5f3   8.6:1   safe for body text
  core.soft  #7fd4fb  12.2:1
  pulse      #c84dfb   5.7:1   safe for body text
  pulse.soft #e3a5ff  10.7:1
  violet     #6651d8   3.6:1   gradient stops and borders only, never text

The sampled violet is the one that cannot carry text, so it is used only
where nothing has to be read against it. Gradients now run magenta to blue,
the direction the artwork reads.

Applied everywhere the old ramp was hardcoded, which was more places than the
hex search first showed: glows and shadows carried it as rgba() triples, and
the portal's stat tiles used literal cyan-500/violet-500 Tailwind classes that
would not have followed the tokens. Those now point at core/pulse, so the
palette has one source of truth. Email templates and the favicon are updated
too, since an invite that still arrived in the old colours would look like a
different company.

up/down stay as they were: they are reserved status colours, not brand.

Also fixes the signups-chart test, which compared the API's label against the
shell's local date rather than the database's. They differ whenever the test
machine is not on the server's clock - as it is right now, with the database a
day ahead - and that difference is precisely the off-by-one the fix addressed.
